name: dTRINITY dLEND empty cbBTC reserve liquidity-index inflation
summary: dLEND, an Aave v3 fork, listed cbBTC as flash-loanable collateral with no supply. The attacker left one scaled share in the empty reserve and ran 150 flash loans whose premiums inflated its liquidity index; deposit/withdraw rounding then let it keep aToken collateral while withdrawing its cbBTC, and two blocks later it borrowed the dUSD reserve against it.
notes: The reset is the cbBTC listing completion: getConfiguration(cbBTC) went from active only to LTV 7300 with flash loans enabled and no supply seeded; both are needed to inflate the index and borrow against it. The aToken's creation and the cbBTC oracle source precede it.

The index transaction is the anchor because it already ran the defective rounding; the dUSD borrow two blocks later is the profit transaction. Loss is the dUSD it took from the dUSD reserve, never repaid; the cbBTC reserve held no third-party funds.
